name: zmodel_render_point_queue_entry
description: zModel_RenderPointQueueEntry transforms and projects a model point, clips it, submits hardware draw-point work when needed, and queues the corresponding lens flare sample.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel point-render helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel render/source-cluster pass.
